svg.title: The Stackz starter layout
svg.desc: Thirteen screen zones on a seven by four grid, one per key. Y, U, I and O are the top-left, top-center, top-right and whole top half. H, J and K are the left, center and right columns, L is the full screen (send only) and semicolon is center plus right. N, M, comma and period are the bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right and whole bottom half. Shift-Command plus a key sends, Control-Shift-Command swaps, Control-Command selects and Control-Shift spins.
svg.text: Thirteen zones on a 7 × 4 grid, arranged like the keys under your right hand.
* Full screen is send-only, on ⌃⇧⌘L. A second full-screen zone, the root of the three-column tree, is on ⌃⇧⌘W.
